games.name: Baker's Game
games.note: FreeCell's free cells, foundations and staged run moves, with one word changed: the columns build in the same suit.

games.name: Double Klondike
games.note: Klondike's stock, waste and turn-up columns stretched over two decks: eight repeated foundations and a nine-column diagonal deal.

games.name: Putt Putt with Jokers
games.note: Golf's one foundation with ranks that wrap from King to Ace, and Jokers that are wild both ways: a Joker plays on anything, and anything plays on a Joker.

games.name: Spiderette
games.note: Spider's row deal, same-suit runs and self-banking foundations, set out on Klondike's seven-column table with one deck.
